description.describe_ch: 本課程為終端課程，由學生依據自己的興趣，分組(2~8人)參與系上教授之各項研究計畫或議題，從文獻資料之蒐集及研讀、實驗進行之規劃、各式儀器設備之操作與學習，進而在學期末針對專題實作構想進行發表。
description.describe_eh: This course is a terminal course. Students are divided into groups (2~8 people) according to their interests to participate in various research projects or topics taught by the department, from collecting and studying literature data, the planning of experiments, and various instruments and equipment. The operation and learning of the project will be published at the end of the semester.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new: 計畫書50％ 期末發表50％ 依「逢甲大學材料科學與工程學系專題實作修課須知」辦理。此外，也會針對於出缺席狀況進行調整分數。」辦理。
